Whether you come alone or with a group of eight or so friends, this place has something for everyone. It's open until 2 a.m. and the prices are reasonable, making it a hidden gem of Seoul's nightlife. I highly recommend it to people who want to have fun late into the night. I've already added it to my list of places I want to visit again.
